long_description: Refabric specializes in offering generative AI tools that are tailored to meet the needs of fashion designers and brands. Our premium offering, Refabric Pro, provides brands and designers the opportunity to curate their own fashion libraries. Gain insights into trending styles, capitalize on data from best-selling products, and utilize AI-assisted design features for your exclusive collections. For those just starting their creative journey or looking for a platform to explore unique fashion designs, Refabric Basic has you covered. This user-friendly platform is trained in fashion design, allowing users to create, explore, and even shop for designs that mirror their own creative ideas. Additionally, we are expanding our offerings to include production, e-commerce and content marketing solutions to further assist brands and designers in achieving their business goals.
